name: Tobias Starr
life: “I still remember getting ink under my sleeve while printing a friend's draft.” Sunday often includes a stop at Maré Coffee, where Tobias likes the table where people coming off shift stop checking the time.
voice: I printed the first draft on my lunch break. I want the other print workers credited for covering for me.
appearance: Tobias has short copper curls, a flat bridge to the nose and a mobile brow, and a favorite piece of clothing, a red windbreaker. It usually goes with a train token tied to a zipper pull. When somebody else has the floor, Tobias turns fully toward the person speaking.
personality: Tobias tells a better story in a kitchen than at a microphone. Family members sometimes underestimate how far Tobias will go to back a quiet opinion once it is actually challenged.
agenda: To credit the workers who covered the printing.
family: Yasmin Arrieta is Tobias’s cousin. Tobias chooses the music. Yasmin puts the kettle on. The cups come out before either brings up the reason for the visit. They trust a difficult conversation more if it has had an ordinary beginning. Asked about *The widow's dividend*, Yasmin says, “I recorded the founding meeting on a birthday cassette.”
connections: Morgan Lim. A translation and a lunch-break proof both owe part of their existence to uncredited coworkers.

reactions.situation: A reader asks for a copy with the page still blank
reactions.response: Tobias keeps a clean, blank copy aside for the reader to dedicate.
reactions.asWritten: A reader asks for a copy with the page still blank. Tobias keeps a clean, blank copy aside for the reader to dedicate.

reactions.situation: Somebody says a missing friend must be avoiding their calls
reactions.response: Tobias offers to accompany the caller to a familiar public meeting place without turning speculation into neighborhood news.

reactions.situation: If a relative makes a joke at a child's expense
reactions.response: Tobias repeats the child's actual point and waits for a reply to that.
